name: HMS Hood
description: The battlecruiser Hood had a standard displacement of 41,785 tons, a speed of 32 knots, four twin 381 mm main guns and a speed of 31 knots. It was the largest warship in the world at the time and was regarded as the pride of the British Navy. It has been used as a ceremonial ship to show the British national majesty and has traveled around the world many times, among which it is well known as the "Empire Cruise".
